method: BASELINE. seat: the learner and the licensed driver

roles: I am learning to drive, or hold a driver's licence
I supervise a learner driver, or ride with a new driver

situation_parameters.name: I hold a learner's permit
questions: Is my learner's permit in force on this day
May this person supervise my driving
Does my learner's permit authorise this drive of mine
What is the fastest I may drive on a learner's permit
What is the most I can be fined for breaking a learner's permit condition

situation_parameters.name: I hold a driver's licence
questions: What kind of novice driver am I now
Must my licence be or stay provisional
What P plates must I display on my car
May I drive between midnight and 5 a.m.
May I carry these passengers in my car

situation_parameters.name: I have committed, or am said to have committed, a traffic offence
questions: How many demerit points does my speeding offence carry
What is the modified penalty for my speeding offence
How many demerit points does my Road Traffic Act offence carry
Has my infringement notice been dealt with
Is WA my registry jurisdiction for demerit points
Will demerit points be recorded against me for this offence
Are the demerit points for this offence still current
For how many months will an excessive demerit points notice disqualify me
Must I be given a novice driver notice for my points

situation_parameters.name: I have been given a demerit points notice
questions: What is the earliest day my demerit points disqualification can start
May I elect a good behaviour year instead of being disqualified

situation_parameters.name: I have made a good behaviour election
questions: Have I broken my good behaviour election
For how many months am I disqualified after breaking my good behaviour election

situation_parameters.name: I have been convicted of a driving offence, or disqualified
questions: Does a licence or permit I obtain while disqualified have any effect
What happens to my licence or permit when I am disqualified
For how many months am I disqualified after losing my provisional licence on conviction
Am I disqualified, as someone unlicensed who would get a provisional licence
How many months must pass before I may apply to remove my court disqualification

situation_parameters.name: I am the person in charge of the vehicle the learner drives
questions: Must I make sure L plates are displayed
What is the most I can be fined if the L plates are not displayed
